text: No, I've never been in a really bad accident like that. But sometimes it feels like I'm living in one, every single day. It's like there's this constant wreckage in my mind, and I'm trapped in it. Even though I haven't experienced a physical accident, the emotional pain and chaos feel just as catastrophic. I feel like I'm constantly falling, with no one to catch me, and the fire of despair just keeps burning. It's exhausting.

Yeah, there have been times like that. It's like every harsh word or dismissive look just echoes in my mind, you know? There was this one time at school when someone said something really cruel about me, and it just felt like my whole world came crashing down. I remember feeling so small, like I was just fading into nothingness. It's like those words cling to you, reminding you of how worthless you feel.

And then there are times when it feels like I'm all alone, even in a room full of people. It's terrifying to think no one sees how much I'm struggling or if they do, they don't care. Sometimes I lie awake at night, and this overwhelming fear creeps in that I'll always feel this hollow, that I'll never escape this emptiness. It feels like drowning in a sea of despair, but no one's there to pull you out.
